reached_sql:
SELECT substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1998
JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
   OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
   OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
